changes.before: (a) The Council is a working cabinet, not a competing ladder of native ranks. Twelve reserved portfolios serve beneath the Guild Master as chair: the Co-Guild Master and Hand of the Sovereign; Lord High Treasurer; Lord High Chancellor and Head of Justice; Grand Marshal of PvE; Grand Marshal of PvP; High Inquisitor and Minister of Internal Security; High Minister of the Chancery and Imperial Census; Grand Concordat Director; Grand Master Artisan; Minister of Propaganda; Lord High Herald; and the dedicated Head of Trading & Markets. The Sovereign may establish further distinct portfolios through an explicit instrument. No published list supplies a holder, a vote or a second native High Council rank. The Addon / Discord Architect serves outside the Council as an Officer Corps technical specialist. The Minister of Propaganda directs creative campaigns, recruitment storytelling and broadcaster-safe promotion; Heraldry retains official records and publication standards. Neither title grants publishing access or a Council vote without the separate accepted authority.
changes.after: (a) The Council is a working cabinet, not a competing ladder of native ranks. Twelve reserved portfolios serve beneath the Guild Master as chair: Hand of the Sovereign · Co-Guild Master; Lord High Treasurer · Minister of the Imperial Exchequer; Lord High Justiciar · Minister of Justice & The Privy Court; Lord High Marshal of PvE · Minister of Raid Campaigns; Lord High Marshal of PvP · Minister of Battlegrounds & Honor; Lord High Inquisitor · Minister of Internal Security; Lord High Chancellor · Minister of the Chancery & Imperial Census; Lord High Legate · Minister of the Grand Concordat; Lord High Artificer · Minister of Artisanry & The Guild Workshop; Lord High Factor · Minister of Trading & Markets; Lord High Herald · Minister of Propaganda; Lord High Seneschal · Minister of Court Protocol & Crown Estates. The Sovereign may establish a further distinct portfolio through an explicit instrument. Existing office keys, holder records and historical ballots retain their identities; the current style grants no appointment, eligible vote, platform permission or additional native rank. The Addon / Discord Architect remains an Officer Corps technical specialist outside the Council.

changes.before: (b) The Hand convenes the working cabinet, resolves cross-portfolio dependencies and keeps a named deputy for continuity. Chancery owns intake standards, verification readiness and trial handovers. Under this current supplement, the Chancery reports directly to the High Council; ORD 02's earlier reporting line under Heraldry is superseded, while Heraldry remains a coordinating communications partner. This current reporting line also supersedes the earlier intake placement in Charter section 1.5, the Minister of Heraldry office entry and Operational Charter O8; O8 remains preserved as historical source text, not a current grant of intake supervision. Concordat owns branch contacts and fair overflow proposals across Olympus I–X. The Grand Marshal of PvE develops progression standards with regional Raid Leaders; the Grand Marshal of PvP develops voluntary campaigns with regional Captains. Their purposes meet in preparation and supply, but neither may silently take the other’s appointment or replace a branch Guild Master’s local command.
changes.after: (b) The Hand convenes the Cabinet, resolves dependencies and arranges named cover. The Chancellor owns the Chancery, intake standards, imperial census and trial handovers, reporting directly to the Council. The Justiciar directs independent Court procedure; the Inquisitor coordinates internal security without deciding a contested case. The two Marshals work with their regional Raid Leaders and PvP Captains; neither replaces a branch Guild Master. The Legate maintains the Olympus I–X Concordat, and the Artificer coordinates the Workshop. The Factor directs market operations within separately approved risk limits while the Treasurer retains custody, budgets and reconciliation. The Herald owns propaganda, truthful official communications, corrections and consenting broadcaster coverage. The Seneschal owns court protocol, precedence, the court calendar and Crown facilities stewardship, with no property, bank or moderation grant. Earlier Heraldry names remain aliases of their original office keys; they create no second Herald or Seneschal appointment. Historical reporting text elsewhere in the adopted source does not override this current division of duties. Under this current supplement, the Chancery reports directly to the High Council; ORD 02's earlier reporting line under Heraldry is superseded, while Heraldry remains a coordinating communications partner. This current reporting line also supersedes the earlier intake placement in Charter section 1.5, the Minister of Heraldry office entry and Operational Charter O8; O8 remains preserved as historical source text, not a current grant of intake supervision.
